title: Content scope
requirement: Represent risk content, context and evidence without prescribing a management process.
acceptance_criterion: Map information without inferring process compliance.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Inferring a complete process or certification from stored content.
status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

title: Case continuity
requirement: Keep a case distinct from register entries, scenarios, scores and occurrences.
acceptance_criterion: Two entries and two scenarios can concern one case without identity collapse.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Merging cases solely because labels or scores match.
status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

title: Document identity and history
requirement: Separate artifact, issued version and expressed content; preserve issued payloads.
acceptance_criterion: Retrieve a superseded issued version without overwriting it.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Historical retrieval silently reads current mutable values.
status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

title: Assessment context
requirement: Retain method, scale, dimension, basis, context and time with results.
acceptance_criterion: Equal scores on incompatible versions remain distinguishable.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Treating missing context as zero or equal values as comparability.
status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

title: Reported and computed scores
requirement: Distinguish supplied scores from calculations with justified pinned inputs.
acceptance_criterion: Retain an unverified reported score; reject a claimed computation with missing required inputs.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Presenting supplied arithmetic as a verified calculation.
status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

title: Source-qualified assertions
requirement: Preserve source content, locator, interpretation origin, corrections and conflicting assertions.
acceptance_criterion: A proposed mapping preserves its source assertion and does not create an occurrence.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Overwriting evidence or treating a correction as independent corroboration.
status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

title: Evidence-qualified responsibility
requirement: Keep assignment information separate from an asserted mandate; ground actual relators with distinct participants.
acceptance_criterion: Retain an assignment record without fabricating an actor or actual mandate.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Inferring Risk Owner or a second actor from documentation alone.
status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

title: Time and workflow
requirement: Separate recorded, reference and validity time and scheme-qualified workflow interpretation.
acceptance_criterion: A closed entry does not establish cessation; an absent rule stays unknown.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Inferring treatment effectiveness or cessation from a state label.
status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

title: External boundaries and modes
requirement: Keep heterogeneous referents optional; vulnerability requires one justified object bearer.
acceptance_criterion: The typed projection excludes untyped boundary notions and preserves bearer dependence.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Treating a description as an actual vulnerability or an untyped boundary as a typed core class.
status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

title: Policies and thresholds
requirement: Preserve source-qualified appetite/tolerance meanings and a compatible indicator or scale anchor.
acceptance_criterion: A scale-only threshold can be represented without inventing an indicator.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Collapsing different source meanings or inventing required evidence.
status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

title: Projection and admission
requirement: Account for model elements and distinguish raw, managed and task-ready data.
acceptance_criterion: An incomplete record remains available without a false readiness declaration.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Confusing data completeness, mapping allocation and semantic adequacy.
status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

title: Quality evidence and reuse
requirement: Bind claims to the exact model, evidence population, method and limits.
acceptance_criterion: Every published result identifies its input version and scope.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Inheriting a result from a different version or treating counts as semantic validity.
status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending
